parsed.name: OBP USB通信组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的USB通信组件，用于海洋光学系列光谱仪的OBP协议通信。它负责打开和关闭USB连接、发送命令、发起与接收查询，以及按不同读取模式获取USB数据，供实验软件与光谱仪进行底层数据交换。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical USB communication component for OBP-based communication with Ocean Optics spectrometers. It handles opening and closing the USB connection, sending commands, initiating and receiving queries, and reading USB data through different transfer modes so that experiment software can exchange low-level data with the spectrometer.
